SELECT 
  ds.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipt_count,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_net_sales,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as avg_transaction_value
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY ds.format
ORDER BY ds.format

SELECT 
  ds.format,
  fsl.channel_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipt_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY ds.format, fsl.channel_code
ORDER BY ds.format, fsl.channel_code

SELECT 
  ds.format,
  dc.channel_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipt_count
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN dim_channel dc ON fsl.channel_id = dc.channel_id
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY ds.format, dc.channel_name
ORDER BY ds.format, dc.channel_name

SELECT 
  ds.store_id,
  ds.store_name,
  ds.format,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 4
  AND ds.format = 'Training'
GROUP BY ds.store_id, ds.store_name, ds.format
